account: Beethoven left only sketches for a Tenth Symphony. For his 250th anniversary, Deutsche Telekom funded a project to complete the work with artificial intelligence. A team led by musicologist Matthias Röder, with AI researcher Ahmed Elgammal and Mark Gotham, trained a model on Beethoven's output. The model generated continuations of the sketches. Composer Walter Werzowa and the musicologists chose and arranged the generated themes. On 9 October 2021 the Beethoven Orchester Bonn under Dirk Kaftan gave the world premiere of the completed symphony at the Telekom Forum in Bonn, in a concert that Deutsche Telekom organized. On 10 October 2021 BR-Klassik critic Henning Hübert reported that Werzowa had to sort through 200 to 300 unusable proposals for each new phrase. He judged that the result sounds conventional and rarely like Beethoven. He also reported that Kaftan told the premiere audience that the work is not Beethoven. Euronews reported on 13 October 2021 that the premiere had taken place in Bonn on 9 October. The benefit is a performed and recorded cultural work. No source claims that the result is Beethoven's own.

ai_role.statement: The model generated candidate continuations of Beethoven's sketches. Humans (Werzowa and the musicologists) selected, arranged and orchestrated them, so the AI contribution was generative input within a human-curated process. The vendor-side accounts (Elgammal in The Conversation; Telekom) and the orchestra's own program page agree on the premiere.

fields.account: Beethoven left only sketches for a Tenth Symphony. For his 250th anniversary, Deutsche Telekom funded a project to complete the work with artificial intelligence. A team led by musicologist Matthias Röder, with AI researcher Ahmed Elgammal and Mark Gotham, trained a model on Beethoven's output. The model generated continuations of the sketches. Composer Walter Werzowa and the musicologists chose and arranged the generated themes. On 9 October 2021 the Beethoven Orchester Bonn under Dirk Kaftan gave the world premiere of the completed symphony at the Telekom Forum in Bonn, in a concert that Deutsche Telekom organized. On 10 October 2021 BR-Klassik critic Henning Hübert reported that Werzowa had to sort through 200 to 300 unusable proposals for each new phrase. He judged that the result sounds conventional and rarely like Beethoven. He also reported that Kaftan told the premiere audience that the work is not Beethoven. Euronews reported on 13 October 2021 that the premiere had taken place in Bonn on 9 October. The benefit is a performed and recorded cultural work. No source claims that the result is Beethoven's own.
